_comment: Optional deployment release proposal. Set a new semantic version and notes before deploying; Avenue Guard will DM the configured owner and publish it only after approval. Leave version blank when no automatic proposal is needed.
title: Startup writes and uptime recovery
summary: Makes uptime setup retry safely under database contention and moves expired validation-cache cleanup out of the request startup path.
changes: Established the uptime startup boundary before background writers and prevented supervisor repairs from racing initial cog startup
Started release/status tasks independently of one-time setup and added automatic bootstrap retries
Made uptime checkpoints timestamp-guarded and retry-safe while retaining delayed online/offline transitions
Kept public uptime snapshots read-only and showed pending persistence in the admin dashboard
Moved expired GD validation-cache deletion into bounded read-first maintenance with short queue waits and backoff
Added transaction labels and owning-task names to database busy diagnostics
Joined release bootstrap/status tasks during shutdown and added 19 startup-recovery regression cases
